# Governance

The ServerOS panel is run by ServerOS Cloud Ltd, the company that makes ServerOS. We build it in the open and welcome contributions, and the maintainers below make the final calls.

## Maintainers

| Name  | GitHub                                             | Role       |
| ----- | -------------------------------------------------- | ---------- |
| Liam  | [@liamdevss](https://github.com/liamdevss)         | Co-founder |
| Harry | [@HarryServerOS](https://github.com/HarryServerOS) | CTO        |

Maintainers are listed in [CODEOWNERS](CODEOWNERS) through the `serveroshq/maintainers` team, and one of them reviews every change.

## How decisions get made

- Day-to-day changes: a maintainer reviews and merges.
- Bigger changes (new features, breaking changes, new dependencies, anything about security or licensing): discussed in an issue or discussion first. The maintainers decide, and say why.
- What goes in the open source panel and what goes in paid editions is decided by ServerOS Cloud Ltd.

## Becoming a maintainer

People who make steady, high-quality contributions and help others in issues and reviews may be asked to join. Maintainers need two-factor authentication on GitHub and agree to follow [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) for anything security-related.

## Changing these rules

Changes to this file, the license, the CLA or the policies go through a pull request that a maintainer approves.
